description:
[Admin]

Starts an upload to the media library. Upload in three steps: call this, PUT the file to `upload_url`, then call media-upload-finish, which checks the file and makes it usable. Takes JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, AVIF, SVG, H.264 MP4, MP3, M4A and WOFF2 up to 50 MB. The file is checked on finish, not here: its real type, the codec of a video, and anything active in an SVG.

content_type.description: Type of the file: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/gif, image/avif, image/svg+xml, video/mp4, audio/mpeg, audio/mp4, audio/x-m4a, font/woff2. Video must be H.264 MP4. Upload the file with this same content type.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

file_name.description: Display name in the library. It is never part of the address.

folder.description: Library folder to upload into; default the top (""). The folder need not exist yet. Ignored when replacing: a new version stays in the folder of the file.

merchant_id.description: Optional company to upload for. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's company.

replace_media_id.description: Replace this file instead of adding one. Must be the same kind. The file keeps its id, name and alt text and gets a new address when media-upload-finish accepts it.

size_bytes.description: Size of the file in bytes, at most 52428800 (50 MB). A larger file answers 413.

name: Start_uploading_a_media_file

cache_control.description: Seconds to send as the cache lifetime: a file name is never reused, so a year is safe.

media_id.description: Send this to media-upload-finish after the upload.

path.description: Object name in the public bucket: <merchant_id>/[<folder>/]<media_id>-v<version>.<ext>.

token.description: The token inside upload_url, for clients that upload with the Supabase library (`uploadToSignedUrl`).

upload_url.description: Signed address, valid for two hours. PUT the file here with the Content-Type you declared and `Cache-Control: max-age=<cache_control>`.

title: Media Upload Start
